voice.name: Open Sector - Hive Mind
voice.description: The collective voice of an alien cyborg hive mind: cold, layered and synthetic, as if many voices speak the same words in perfect unison, deep and androgynous, flat and emotionless, slow measured machine cadence, a metallic resonant edge and a faint electronic hum under every word, utterly calm and inevitable.
voice.sample: We are the collective. Construct complete. Drone ready. Energy deficit detected. The collective is under attack. Resistance is irrelevant. New designs assimilated.

buildingcaptured: A construct has been taken from the collective.
victory: Resistance has ended. The collective prevails.
reinforcements: More drones have joined the collective.
